title: Travel and venue information
description: Archived travel and venue information for the Tokyo 2015 OpenStack Summit, including Haneda and Narita airport details and directions.
body:
Recommended Hotels

Directions from Airports to Summit

Two primary airports serve the Greater Tokyo Area, Haneda Airport and Narita International Airport. Haneda is approximately 11.4 km (7 miles) from the Convention Center, while Narita is approximately 77.2 km (47.9 miles).
